{{Quote|We're a ''Burst Fire–class'' Deep-Space Patrol Vessel&mdash;what we like to call a pocket corvette. We have a crew of thirty.|Phison regarding the Concussor|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''''Concussor''''' was a [[Burst Fire-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel|''Burst Fire''-class Deep-Space Patrol Vessel]]. Originally in service of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], it was seized by the recently reformed [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]]<ref name="MK" /> in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> ''Concussor'' was self-destructed by the Wraiths after a confrontation with the Galactic Alliance [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[Starhook]]''.<ref name="MK" />
